price.seriesDefinition: Gold, spot average of daily rates, from June 2025; previously (UK), 99.5% fine, London afternoon fixing, average of daily rates

stock.formula: S(y) = S(2025) - sum(world mine production from y+1 through 2025)
stock.status: Reconstructed analytical estimate, not an official WGC historical stock series. Assumes negligible irreversible physical losses. Splices USGS and WGC production definitions and vintages. The 2025 anchor is revised hindsight information; any signal study is descriptive rather than an investable real-time backtest.

currentPublishedStock.note: Q3 headline 224200 is current; same page intro still says 222600 from Q2. These current snapshots are rounded to 100t.

cycles.name: 脱钩后的第一轮
cycles.context: 官方兑换承诺终止后，金价重新定价。随后 1975—1976 年出现明显调整。

cycles.name: 七十年代的再加速
cycles.context: 通胀与货币信用担忧推动上涨；高比率也出现在接近顶部的阶段。

cycles.name: 新世纪的长期牛市
cycles.context: 覆盖美元走弱、金融危机与危机后宽松。这一轮最能显示分母口径的影响。

cycles.name: 低点到疫情新高
cycles.context: 金价上涨的同时，联邦债务也扩张。比率未必同步越过牛市阈值。

cycles.name: 最近一轮上涨窗口
cycles.context: 观察至共同数据截止月，包含上涨后的回落；不是对这一轮最终顶部的判断。
